name: Pulmonary Artery Coming from Patent Ductus Arteriosus
aliases: Pulmonary Artery Originating from Patent Ductus Arteriosus
Anomalous Pulmonary Artery from Patent Ductus Arteriosus

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Congenital Pulmonary Artery Anomaly Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Confirmation of pulmonary artery arising directly from patent ductus arteriosus by echocardiography or cardiac MRI
Presence of signs of pulmonary overcirculation such as tachypnea and failure to thrive in infancy
Absence or hypoplasia of the normal pulmonary artery origin from the right ventricular outflow tract

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Imaging confirmation of pulmonary artery arising from patent ductus arteriosus plus absence or hypoplasia of normal pulmonary artery origin
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on advanced cardiac imaging modalities.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Continuous cardiac murmur due to patent ductus arteriosus
searchTerms: continuous heart murmur from open vessel
heart noise from patent ductus arteriosus
blue skin from abnormal heart blood flow
cyanosis due to right-to-left heart shunt
signs of high blood pressure in lungs
enlarged right heart muscle on ECG

laboratory: Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) in heart failure
imaging: Echocardiography demonstrating pulmonary artery arising from patent ductus arteriosus
Cardiac MRI or CT angiography confirming anomalous pulmonary artery origin
Chest X-ray showing cardiomegaly and increased pulmonary vascular markings
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; may be sporadic congenital anomaly

distinguishingFeatures: Normal origin of pulmonary artery from right ventricular outflow tract
Localized narrowing rather than anomalous origin
Pulmonary artery arises normally from right ventricle

redFlags: Severe cyanosis unresponsive to oxygen therapy
Signs of congestive heart failure in neonate
references: Gatzoulis MA, et al. Diagnosis and Management of Congenital Heart Disease. Circulation. 2019.
Orphanet: Pulmonary artery coming from patent ductus arteriosus (ORPHA:99049)
